arch_rulings: SCOPE IS DISPLAY-LAYER ON BOTH HALVES. The price column POINTS AT EXISTING DATA (source column literally named 'price' in the vendor excel) -- this is not a pipeline change, not a new field derivation, and not a vendor call. Likewise the DataRefresh half is a LIST/COPY change, not an upload-path change: the upload already succeeds. Anything that turns into a pipeline edit has left this project's scope and should be surfaced, not absorbed.

COLUMN PLACEMENT IS SPECIFIED, NOT FREE: price goes IMMEDIATELY BEFORE market cap. Andrew, 19:07Z: 'oh ok I can just add price to column before market cap'. Both tabs (Universe Data + Universe Scanner) get it.

SPANS TWO MACRO SURFACES, filed under the PRIMARY per MACRO_CODES.md rule 5. SSCN (SecurityScanner) is primary and carries the project code; DRFR (DataRefresh) is the secondary affected surface. Recorded rather than split because it is one job, one seat, one deploy.
measured_scope_facts: WHY PRICE IS WANTED -- the motivating defect, from the thread: Andrew was visually spot-checking market caps and found ticker 'AU' listed at ~44.2b in the dataset against ~48.6b externally. Cause, his words: 'because it literally shot up 10%'. Yang: 'we probably should put the stock price in there'. So price is a SANITY-CHECK AFFORDANCE for a stale-looking market cap, not a new analytic. That is worth carrying because it tells the implementer what the column is FOR: a human eyeballing whether a cap number is plausible.
